errors.text: The predicted fracture response contradicts the target: the generated hypothesis says fracture strain remains low, whereas the key result is a roughly 20.6% increase from about 11.6% to 14.0% due to plasticity compensation and crack-growth impediment by the reticulated Laves phase.

The proposed Cr-free versus Cr-added comparison does not fully separate Cr solid-solution effects from Cr-induced Laves-phase effects, because both change simultaneously. A same-composition control with suppressed or altered Laves-phase formation is needed.
